medium: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: square team-member avatar, legible at 32 and 56 pixels. Image 1 is the exact character to remake; preserve its identity, silhouette, pose, framing, expression, gaze, asymmetry, accessories and all color relationships. Image 2 is ONLY the material reference: its densely needle-felted wool, tiny short fibers, softly sculpted volumes and quiet diffuse lighting. Transform Image 1 into an original handmade needle-felt miniature portrait with the same nonrealistic illustration design. The change is material, not character design. Face and every accessory are solid colored felt, with fine compact fuzzy edges and delicate shallow relief. Keep the single colored background from Image 1, now a plain soft felt surface of the same hue. Match the close head crop and proportions of Image 1. Refined, witty, slightly eccentric, restrained. No realistic human skin or anatomy, no photoreal human, no beauty makeover, no baby proportions or enlarged eyes, no generic cute mascot. No crochet, knitting, woven fabric, exposed stitches, seams, long fur, glitter, plastic, clay, gloss, dramatic shadows, extra props, added scenery, borders, lettering or watermark. Full-bleed square, one character only. Do not import the cat, pose, blue background or facial expression from Image 2; use only its wool material quality.

corrections.evan: Precise local image edit. Image 1 is the generated felt avatar to edit; Image 2 is the approved illustration for facial proportions. Change ONLY the eyes and smile in Image 1 to the restrained expression of Image 2. Make the eyes small plain matte dark felt circles, about 5 percent of the image width each, slightly unequal in size. Remove the large ivory eye rings completely; there is no eye white, no sclera, no glass glint. Embed the two small eyes directly into the sage felt face. Replace the broad grin with the original quiet thin slightly crooked smile, narrower and less upturned. Keep everything else from Image 1 exactly: square crop, head shape, ivory and sage face, long nose, vermilion side knob, black collar, brick-red backdrop, short needle-felt wool material, light and composition. Do not add anything. No text, no border, no new props. The character should look thoughtful and a little eccentric, not childlike or surprised.
corrections.riley: Precise local image edit. Image 1 is the generated felt avatar to edit; Image 2 is the approved illustration for facial proportions and gaze. Change ONLY the eyes inside the red glasses in Image 1. Restore the original small understated dark eyes and observant sideways glance from Image 2. Reduce the eye shapes by at least half; make the pupils solid matte black felt with no glass shine, and remove the large white sclera shapes entirely. They should be small expressive dark almond marks, not big toy eyes. Keep the existing red glasses and their dimensions, green face, swept dark-blue hair, ivory nose, red cheek patch, ears, mouth, striped collar, aqua felt background, dense wool texture, lighting and square crop exactly unchanged. No other edits, no text, no border. Quiet adult confidence, not cuteness.

jules.subject: Retain Jules: coral-red stylized face in three-quarter view looking right, thoughtful almond eyes, short cobalt-blue swept tousled hair and the small vermilion pencil behind the ear. Keep the angular cheek and calm curious expression, minimal neck, pale yellow background. Hair is shaped cobalt felt locks with fine short wool fibers, never realistic hair. The pencil is a tiny simple felt form. Preserve the original ear, nose and eyebrow shapes.

nora.subject: Retain Nora: energetic orange-red human profile looking right, distinctive large angular nose, one attentive eye, black rounded curly hair, ivory headphone-like band and ear shapes, a small open dark smile and cobalt-blue collar. Keep the confident irregular graphic silhouette and pale cool pink background. Translate every shape, including the ivory band and ear pieces, into dense sculpted felt. Keep the adult expressive proportions and original profile, not a rounded doll face.

theo.subject: Retain Theo: the charcoal-black cat with broad angular head and asymmetrical pointed ears, narrow half-closed yellow eyes, small ivory muzzle and chest, and tiny red cheek mark. Preserve the original deadpan sideways stare and discerning expression. Keep the muted periwinkle-blue background. Black short dense needle-felt wool with clean sculptural planes; yellow eyes must remain narrow, not circular or cute. Do not make a realistic cat photograph or substitute the white cat from Image 2.

evan.subject: Retain Evan: the asymmetric tall pale-sage and ivory rectangular automaton head, small dark circular eyes, long simple faceted nose, crooked curved smile, one vermilion side knob and dark collar. Keep the subtle handmade geometric asymmetry and brick-red background. All pieces, including the eyes, ear knob and nose, are compact needle-felt wool, with softly rounded edges but the same rectangular silhouette. No metal parts, screws, seams or robot emoji redesign.

riley.subject: Retain Riley: the olive-green stylized face with observant dark eyes, dramatic swept ink-blue hair, brick-red round glasses, ivory long nose, larger ear and tiny striped ivory collar. Keep the original thoughtful slight sideways glance, characterful asymmetric silhouette and muted aqua background. Render glasses as fine sculpted red felt, hair as swept dark-blue felt forms. Preserve the face color and mature reserved expression; do not add a smile, wrinkles, skin shading or office clothing.
